pr.title: feat(etag): allow for custom hashing methods to be used to etag

summary: This PR adds support for custom hashing methods in the ETag middleware by introducing an optional `generateDigest` parameter. The implementation preserves backward compatibility by defaulting to SHA-1 when no custom generator is provided. The PR includes tests for the new feature with SHA-256. However, there is a test gap: the new custom generator feature is not tested for the 304 conditional GET response case, only for normal 200 responses.

findings.rationale: The new test for custom digest generation (SHA-256) only verifies the 200 response case (lines 43-53). It does not test the 304 conditional GET scenario where the custom generator is used with If-None-Match headers. The existing 'Should handle conditional GETs' test (line 170) covers 304 responses but only with the default SHA-1 algorithm. This leaves a gap in test coverage for the custom generator path in the 304 response scenario.
findings.suggestedCheck: Add a test case that uses the custom generateDigest option and verifies the 304 Not Modified response is correctly generated with the custom hash algorithm when If-None-Match headers match.
